ItemID: NA; Title: DEWALT Cutting Wheel, General Purpose Metal Cutting, 4-1/2-Inch, 5-Pack (DW8062B5), Multi; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My clamp and repair purchases do not establish a current need for metal cutting or compatible equipment.
ItemID: NA; Title: J-B Weld ClearWeld 5 Minute Epoxy, Clear, Syringe, 2 Pack, 50112-2; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this for small repairs where a clear bond would be useful, complementing my tape and vinyl cement.
ItemID: NA; Title: Wirefy Heat Shrink Tubing Kit - 3:1 Ratio Adhesive Lined, Marine Grade Shrink Wrap - Industrial Heat-Shrink Tubing - Black 180 PCS; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would choose this to insulate and protect connections made with my existing electrical terminal assortment.
ItemID: NA; Title: 32 Blades Steel Feeler Gauge Dual Marked Metric and Imperial Measuring Tool; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: I have no specific clearance-measuring task in mind, so this is too specialized for this visit.
ItemID: NA; Title: SELTERM 25pcs 4 AWG 3/8" Stud Battery Lugs, Ring Terminals, Heavy Duty Copper Wire Lugs, Battery Cable Ends, 4 Guage Ring Terminal Connectors, UL Bare Copper Eyelets Electrical Battery Cable Lugs; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: My previous small-wire connectors do not imply a need for these particular heavy battery cable terminals.
ItemID: NA; Title: Kuject 120PCS Solder Seal Wire Connectors, Self-Solder Heat Shrink Butt Connector Solder Sleeve Waterproof Insulated Electrical Butt Splice Wire Terminals for Marine Automotive Boat Truck Wire Joint; ALIGN: yes; RATING: 4; REASON: I would try these for sealed wire splices, a useful addition to the quick-disconnect terminals I already bought.
ItemID: NA; Title: SELTERM 5pcs 2/0 AWG 5/16" Stud Tinned Copper Wire Lugs, Battery Lugs, Ring Terminals, Battery Cable Ends, 00 Gauge Ring Terminal Connectors, UL Marine Grade Electrical Battery Terminal Connectors; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: These require a very specific cable and stud size, and I have no matching project indicated.
ItemID: NA; Title: J-B Weld Original Epoxy, Steel Reinforced Epoxy, High Strength - 2 Pack, Dark Grey (8265S-2); ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: A strong repair adhesive is relevant, but I would choose the clear epoxy this time rather than buy another formulation without a specific repair.
ItemID: NA; Title: CRC 05103 QD Electronic Cleaner -11 Wt Oz; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: Buying electrical connectors does not mean I currently need to clean electronic contacts.
ItemID: NA; Title: J-B Weld 8271 KwikWeld Professional Size Steel Reinforced Epoxy Twin Pack - 10 oz.; ALIGN: no; RATING: NA; REASON: This quantity feels unnecessary for my occasional repair purchases, especially with a smaller epoxy already selected.
